t: All Things Shining | Book by Hubert Dreyfus, Sean Dorrance Kelly | Official Publisher Page | Simon & Schuster
s: August 9, 2011 - Through their original and transformative discussion of some of the greatest works of Western literature, from Homer’s Odyssey to Melville’s Moby Dick, Dreyfus and Kelly reveal how we have lost our passionate engagement with the things that gave our lives purpose, and show how, by reading our culture’s classics anew, we can once again be drawn into intense involvement with the wonder and beauty of the world.
